array.string: R="$HOME/.local/share/coding-stats/andrewbrook-dev"; [ -d "$R/.git" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$R")" && /usr/bin/git clone -q https://github.com/AndyFooBlah/andrewbrook-dev.git "$R"; }; /usr/bin/git -C "$R" fetch -q origin main && /usr/bin/git -C "$R" checkout -q -B main origin/main; exec /bin/bash "$R/scripts/coding-stats/refresh.sh"
